question.nlq: Hey! Could you help me list the users and tags with more than 1000 posts? I'd love to see their names and IDs.

meanings.hidden_knowledge: The condition 'with more than 1000 posts' applies only to tags, not to users.
The condition 'with more than 1000 posts' applies to both users and tags.
meanings.gt_sql:
SELECT u.Id, u.DisplayName AS Name
FROM users u
JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
HAVING COUNT(p.Id) > 1000
UNION ALL
SELECT t.Id, t.TagName AS Name
FROM tags t
WHERE t.Count > 1000;

FROM users u
WHERE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM posts p WHERE p.OwnerUserId = u.Id) > 1000
UNION ALL

FROM tags t
WHERE t.Count > 1000;

SELECT Id AS identifier, DisplayName AS name, 'user' AS type FROM users WHERE Id IN (SELECT OwnerUserId FROM posts GROUP BY OwnerUserId HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000) UNION ALL SELECT Id AS identifier, TagName AS name, 'tag' AS type FROM tags WHERE Count > 1000;

  SELECT OwnerUserId AS Id, COUNT(*) AS post_count
  FROM posts
  WHERE OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY OwnerUserId

),
tag_counts AS (

  FROM tags

)

JOIN user_counts uc ON u.Id = uc.Id
UNION ALL
SELECT t.Id, t.Name, 'Tag' AS Type
FROM tag_counts t;
